fields.title: 📖 The Qurʾān is not created
fields.body:
🖋️ **ʿAmr ibn Dīnār** said:

> ***“I met nine of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, who said: Whoever says that the Qurʾān is created is a Kāfir.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The statement shows how immense the question of the **Kalām of Allah** was among the early Imāms.

immutable.source: 📝 al-Lālakāʾī, Sharḥ Uṣūl Iʿtiqād Ahl as-Sunnah, Bāb: al-Qurʾān Kalām Allah ghayr makhlūq, Athar Nr. 380, Band 2, S. 253–254.
